title: RngRange: signed-int32 overflow UB on spans > 2^31 in the final Lo + offset addition
detail: For spans > 2^31 with a draw ≥ 2^31, the int32_t cast wraps negative and Lo+offset overflows int32 — undefined behavior, proven by UBSan (seed 0). Violates the function's own ODN-10 well-definedness claim.
recommended_fix: Do the addition in int64 and cast once: return (int32_t)((int64_t)Lo + (int64_t)(((uint64_t)RngNext(R) * Span) >> 32)); — the result is always in [Lo, Hi], so no overflow.

title: run-tests-headless.sh --probe --json-out with no value passes green with no artifact
evidence:
JSON_OUT=""
    if [ "${1:-}" = "--json-out" ]; then
      JSON_OUT="${2:-}"
      shift 2
    fi
    ARGS=""
    [ -n "$JSON_OUT" ] && ARGS="-json=$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)/$JSON_OUT"

    if ! grep -q "PPProbe RESULT=OK" Saved/Logs/headless-probe.log; then
...
    if [ -n "$JSON_OUT" ]; then
      if [ ! -f "$JSON_OUT" ]; then

bash simulation of `set -- "--json-out"; JSON_OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2` → JSON_OUT="" (verified: rc=1, params unchanged, script continues under set -uo pipefail without -e)
detail: With --json-out but no value, JSON_OUT stays empty, ARGS stays empty, the artifact checks (lines 84-93) are skipped, and the probe exits 0 on RESULT=OK — a passing gate with no artifact.
recommended_fix: Reject the missing operand before building ARGS: JSON_OUT="${2:-}"; if [ -z "$JSON_OUT" ]; then echo "--json-out requires a path" >&2; exit 2; fi

title: Step(): equal-tick re-entry unguarded — redraws the nonce for an already-applied tick
detail: Only Tick < State.Tick is rejected; Step(S, S.Tick) re-enters, consumes an owned-RNG draw and redraws TickNonce for an already-applied tick — the duplicate-tick boundary is unguarded and untested.
recommended_fix: Make Step idempotent on the current tick (return when Tick == State.Tick) or document the redraw; add an equal-tick case to FPPStepGuards and spine_check.

title: SerializeState: null Out pointer with sufficient capacity is unguarded
detail: Capacity is guarded; the pointer is not. Out=nullptr with OutCapacity >= 45 writes through null. The sibling primitive Fnv1a64 tolerates nullptr input; SerializeState does not.
recommended_fix: Extend the guard: if (Out == nullptr || OutCapacity < Needed) return 0; — matching Fnv1a64's null-input tolerance.

title: PPProbe -ticks values ≥ 2^32 silently truncate to the wrong count
detail: FCString::Atoi is (int32)wcstol, so -ticks=4294967297 truncates to 1, passes the V<1 check, and silently runs one tick — contradicting the same function's 'garbage values fail loudly' comment.
recommended_fix: Parse ticks with FCString::Strtoi64 and reject values outside [1, INT32_MAX], mirroring the -seed= parsing path, so out-of-range values fail loudly instead of truncating.
